2014.texte: Marathon participation peaked in 2014 with 496,178 participants.

2018.texte: Over the following 4 years, participation slowly declined to 411,792, a yearly decline of 4.4%.

2020.texte: COVID-19 made marathon running (almost) inaccessible, with just 142,590 participants (-65%) in 2020

2024.texte: marathon participation is back to levels exceeding the participation prior to COVID-19, with 432,562 participants in 2024
